issue.title: 🐛 parse_date crashes on Hindi month names: "5 मार्च 2024"
issue.body:
Bonjour 👋 — when I pass a date with a Hindi month name, datekit raises instead of returning a date or a clear error:

```
>>> parse_date("5 मार्च 2024")
UnicodeEncodeError: 'charmap' codec can't encode characters in position 2-6
```

English month names (`5 March 2024`) work fine. Running on Windows 11, datekit 2.3.0. Merci! 🙏
